Case study · Branding + Paid Advertising

A Category-Defining Brand That Tripled Admissions

How a specialist coaching institute out-positioned larger, older competitors — and grew enough to open a new branch.

IndustryEducation
LocationIndia
ServicesBranding & Paid Ads

The numbers

What changed

300%increase in admissions
New branchopened by the client
Enquiries ↑& social engagement up

01 · Brief

The Challenge

  1. The institute coaches creative students for entry into Architecture, Design and Fashion Design, differentiated by small batch sizes, personal attention and career-focused learning.
  2. It competed against large, long-established coaching classes operating in the same area.
  3. It had no online visibility to speak of.
  4. It had less faculty experience than its bigger competitors, making differentiation harder.

02 · Approach

Our Approach

  1. Studied competitors’ digital strategies and found they nearly all relied on identical messaging.

  2. Used that gap to build a distinctive, category-defining brand and digital experience that showcased the institute’s real differentiators — small batches, personal attention and long-term career focus.

  3. Ran targeted paid advertising to drive enquiries and admissions.

03 · Outcome

The Results

  • Increased admissions by 300%.
  • Grew enquiries and social media engagement significantly.
  • Performed strongly enough to enable the client to open a new branch.
